source.title: WCA Regulations — August 2020: Now in Effect
source.content: New WCA [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and [Guidelines](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html) are in effect as of August 1, 2020. Please see the [original announcement](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-regulations-august-2020) for details.

translation.title: 2020 年 8 月版 WCA 规则现已生效
translation.content: 新版 WCA [规则](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)和[指南](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html)已于 2020 年 8 月 1 日生效。详情请参阅[原公告](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-regulations-august-2020)。
translation.revisionReason: 完成当前版本独立审校；正文未改。
